verdict.rationale: Ramp supports recurring work mainly from outside the product. The AI Agents guide recommends the CLI for "scripted/scheduled workflows," with non-interactive flags (--agent, --no-input, RAMP_PROFILE), and agents.ramp.com offers "long-running access — for background agents that run on a schedule." Built-in recurring automation is limited to fixed features such as auto top-up to a target balance and recurring-budget spend program templates; webhooks are event-triggered rather than scheduled, so the actual scheduler (cron, CI or a handler service) must be supplied by the user. Missing for 10: a native, user-configurable scheduler for custom recurring jobs or workflows, documentation of how to define and manage schedules inside Ramp, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled-workflow use.
